title: Story premise ENT063: The Camouflage Coat Check
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (perception and hidden objects). Hook: Your coat is here. So are you. Probably. Takeaway/theme: Changing the background can reveal the subject.
description: A coat-check attendant must find a customer’s checkerboard coat, but it vanishes against the identical wall pattern. Instead of repainting anything, the attendant slides a plain screen behind the rack and every coat becomes visible; the customer had also blended into the opposite wall.
